mapper.select: SELECT id, household_id, name, management_type, category_id, brand_id, unit_id, cover_file_id, memo, expiry_reminder_mode, expiry_reminder_days, low_stock_mode, low_stock_threshold, status, archived_at, archived_by, created_at, updated_at, version FROM catalog_item WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catalog_item_tag (household_id, item_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{householdId}, #{itemId}, #{tagId})
mapper.select: SELECT tag_id FROM catalog_item_tag WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_item WHERE unit_id = #{unitId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT id, household_id, name, management_type, category_id, brand_id, unit_id, cover_file_id, memo, expiry_reminder_mode, expiry_reminder_days, low_stock_mode, low_stock_threshold, status, archived_at, archived_by, created_at, updated_at, version FROM catalog_item WHERE household_id = #{householdId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND name IS NOT NULL AND btrim(name) <> '' AND strpos(lower(#{question}), lower(name)) > 0 ORDER BY name ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT i.id AS item_id, i.name AS item_name, CASE WHEN b.name IS NOT NULL AND btrim(b.name) <> '' AND strpos(lower(#{question}), lower(b.name)) > 0 THEN b.name ELSE NULL END AS matched_brand_name, ( SELECT t.name FROM catalog_item_tag it INNER JOIN catalog_tag t ON t.id = it.tag_id AND t.household_id = it.household_id WHERE it.item_id = i.id AND it.household_id = i.household_id AND t.name IS NOT NULL AND btrim(t.name) <> '' AND strpos(lower(#{question}), lower(t.name)) > 0 ORDER BY char_length(t.name) DESC, t.name ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS matched_tag_name FROM catalog_item i LEFT JOIN catalog_brand b ON b.id = i.brand_id AND b.household_id = i.household_id WHERE i.household_id = #{householdId} AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( ( b.name IS NOT NULL AND btrim(b.name) <> '' AND strpos(lower(#{question}), lower(b.name)) > 0 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM catalog_item_tag it INNER JOIN catalog_tag t ON t.id = it.tag_id AND t.household_id = it.household_id WHERE it.item_id = i.id AND it.household_id = i.household_id AND t.name IS NOT NULL AND btrim(t.name) <> '' AND strpos(lower(#{question}), lower(t.name)) > 0 ) ) ORDER BY i.name ASC, i.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_item SET low_stock_threshold = ROUND(low_stock_threshold, #{newScale}) WHERE unit_id = #{unitId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND low_stock_threshold IS NOT NULL
